title: i95_route
description: Resolves origin/destination (label or node id) against oracles/i95.json, Transurban's own published 95/395/495 Express Lanes network, to the od_pair_id(s) into trip_pricing_i95 — then prices each key over RDS as of at_time (default: now, America/New_York), falling back to Transurban's own live snapshot (trip_pricing_i95_live) for the 16 od_pair_ids VDOT's feed has never published. Transurban already enumerates every valid direction+entry+exit trip directly, including cross-corridor trips billed as two whole separate tolls, so route resolution is a flat lookup, never traversal. Design: docs/oracle-tools-spec.md; version enforced by tests/test_tool_schemas.py.

origin.description: Ramp label (e.g. 'Route 267'), case-insensitive, or the oracle's raw node id (e.g. '182NO') as a fallback.

at_time.description: ISO-8601 timestamp (e.g. '2026-07-26T14:32:00' or with an explicit UTC offset); a value with no offset is assumed America/New_York. Defaults to now (America/New_York) if omitted. The price returned is the most recently published row at or before this time, never the price this instant -- VDOT's own feed trails real-time by roughly 10-20 minutes (docs/oracle-findings.md section 7); each leg's priced_as_of exposes exactly how stale.

origin.description: Echoes the caller's raw input string.

destination.description: Echoes the caller's raw input string.

at_time.description: The resolved, ISO-8601 time actually used for pricing (the caller's at_time, or now in America/New_York if omitted).

legs.description: One priced leg for a within-corridor trip, two for a cross-corridor trip, in billed order (never chained or summed by this tool).

source.description: Which source priced this leg. "unpriced_gap": one of the 16 known VDOT gap ids (1374-1389) with no row in either real source at at_time -- price_usd is a flagged "0.00" placeholder, never a confirmed fare.

facility_group.description: expresslanes.com markets the 495 Express Lanes as a separate facility from the 95/395 Express Lanes; this classifies the leg accordingly.

corridor_name.description: VDOT's own corridor_name for this leg, or null for a trip_pricing_i95_live/unpriced_gap leg -- that source has no zone/corridor identity.

priced_as_of.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the row actually used (typically earlier than at_time), or null for an unpriced_gap leg, which has no row at all.

facility_totals.description: Always carries both keys ("0.00" if a group has no legs) -- a stable shape, no branching on key presence.

error.description: Unknown origin/destination identifier, no direct trip between a known pair, an ambiguous match (unreachable today), a malformed at_time, no priced row found for a non-gap od_pair_id in either trip_pricing_i95 or trip_pricing_i95_live at or before at_time, a non-gap od_pair_id whose only known row(s) are closed/unavailable for that lane (link_status/status not open), or an unrecognized corridor_name/road value (schema drift beyond the classification this tool knows about).

valid_options.description: Non-empty only for resolution errors, where it lists self-correction candidates (the full ramp label list on an unknown identifier, or the reachable destination labels from a known origin). Empty for a malformed at_time, a pricing miss, or an unrecognized classification value, since retrying the same inputs won't fix any of those.
